title: Rebuilding leisure without chasing more

captions.physics: Abandoning a leisure programme that fails

meaning: Leaving a failed programme supports leisure when adding pleasure leaves room for both people’s naturally changing moods.
text: Sometimes leisure together begins by recognising that the prepared programme obstructs enjoyment. The Tower in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes abandoning a scheme built on a mistaken expectation. The Empress in energy leans towards filling the released time more richly. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions allows excitement, quiet and renewed interest to be felt. Dismantling the inconvenient plan is therefore insufficient on its own. Both need freedom to avoid another chase for abundance expected to maintain an identical mood throughout the evening.

For example, you intended to visit every stage at a large festival, but discover that walking between them takes longer than the performances. **Living leisure can begin after abandoning the need to fit everything in.** You can choose one stage and sit together. Quiet after lively music need not indicate a poor replacement plan. The outing remains shared when each can name a next interest or freely decline another treat or compulsory move for greater richness.

The difficulty is rescuing a collapsed scheme by intensifying experience. You change stages, add entertainment and become more concerned about a quieter mood. Performance replaces participation again. A changing response needs no immediate repair. Leaving the false condition helps when choosing less stays possible. One shared performance and a short conversation can be enough despite further promises of supposedly fuller enjoyment.
